units.translation: Hear my commands: instead of "of my commands". Thus Aeschylus (fr. 423).
Hear the fortunes that are creeping upon you.
I desire to hear your toils throughout.
For the words you have now heard.
This is the end of the whole journey.
Do you hear or do you not hear the clash of shields?
For you will hear the whole story, Darius.
Or many—I grieved when I heard—sufferings.
Having heard trustworthy proofs from you.
Know that you have heard such things, hearing the truth.
No one of the prosperous hears these things.
And you hear this ordinance of my oaths.
Hearing such things, write them in your heart.
Hear the sound at the courtyard door.
Having heard so much, I spoke.
He calls those who hear nothing.
I call you to witness that you hear these things.
Or do you hear these things?
To hear the voice of Tereus' wife.
Hear the ends of many reverent words.
I heard a word that lashes the heart.
I heard a word not at all hospitable.
You hear clear words from a free-speaking tongue.
We hear that the king himself escaped with little.
I hear that the Indian nomads ride on camels.
with genitive of the person and accusative of the thing
And having heard these things, may I not be caught by deceit.
And indeed I hear the neighing of horses.
Having heard my prayers in my weariness.
None of the gods hears prayers.
Such are the counsels and words of the mad to hear.
And one can hear the voices of the conquered and the conquerors, a double calamity.
But a night-covering anxiety remains to hear something from me.
Having heard these unexpected and new words from your father.
And they heard bitterly the things done by me.
And if someone will not obey my rule.
Since I have been brought to hear these things from you.
Since you do not hear sharply my words.
[Ag. 803 corrupted from ἐκ θυσιῶν [from sacrifices]. See under θυσία [sacrifice].]
[Pr. 677 Λέρνης ἄκρην τε [and the height of Lerna] corrupted from Λέρνης τε κρήνην [and the spring of Lerna], which Canter restored.]
not coming to an end, ineffectual
The arts of Calchas are not unfulfilled.
